description: This file provides a wrapper around the MinIO client for uploading, downloading, and managing objects in a specific MinIO bucket, including configuration, helper functions, and error handling.

methods.name: ensure_bucket
methods.description: Ensures the specified MinIO bucket exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: put_object
methods.description: Uploads a file-like object to MinIO.

methods.name: put_bytes
methods.description: Uploads raw bytes to MinIO as an object.

methods.name: get_object_to_bytes
methods.description: Downloads an object from MinIO and returns its bytes content.

methods.name: presigned_get_url
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for GET access to an object.
